summary.en: Taliban forces destroyed the entrance of a mosque in Maidan Wardak, while Russia increased diplomatic engagement with the Taliban-led Afghan government. Afghanistan’s banking sector lost a key lifeline as a Pakistani bank withdrew, and a Russian military aircraft crashed, killing 19 people. Pakistan’s Alsons Group and ZGI Robotics jointly produced the X1 loitering munition, and Saudi Delta Energy announced a $30 billion gas infrastructure investment in Pakistan. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Talibanstyrkene ødela inngangen til en moské i Maidan Wardak, mens Russland økte diplomatisk kontakt med den Taliban-ledede afghanske regjeringen. Afganistans banksystem mistet en viktig livslinje da en pakistansk bank trakk seg tilbake, og et russisk militærfly styrtet og drepte 19 personer. Pakistans Alsons Group og ZGI Robotics produserte i fellesskap loiteringsmunisjonen X1, og Saudi Delta Energy kunngjorde en investering på 30 milliarder dollar i gassinfrastruktur i Pakistan. Konflikten registrerte 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
